PR #942 FOLLOW-UP ON BRANCH plan/s4-page: APPLY THE GAME'S PRIMARY PORT RULES EXACTLY. CHANGE ONLY apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/ (model.ts, BuildOrder.svelte, PlanWorkspace.svelte, plan.css if needed, and their tests), apps/web/cypress/e2e/plan.cy.ts only if a selector moved, and ONE PARAGRAPH of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-v3-colony-planner-design.md (item 2 of section 2). NO API, STORAGE-FORMAT OR DEPENDENCY CHANGES.

Why: the owner confirmed in game, and the Colonization Mega Guide v2.3.0 in docs/reference/colonisation/sources/mega-guide-v2.3.0/mega-guide-v2.3.0.txt says, that:
- the commander picks the Primary Port's TYPE (it must be a spaceport) when making the claim;
- its LOCATION is pre-set by the game and cannot be changed (lines ~290 and ~2091);
- it "can NEVER be changed once built (it can only be canceled or abandoned before it is built)" (line ~677, rule RB-0008);
- it "can be canceled before being completed, but CANNOT be deconstructed after being completed" (line ~1326). Cancelling it cancels the claim.

The previous commit (38ec952d) still lets the commander remove the first site in some cases (`removeSite(model, siteId, isPort)` with a next-site port check). Replace that with the rules below.

RULES for the first site (the Primary Port, `sites[0]`), by its status. Put these in ONE exported helper in model.ts, for example `primaryPortLocks(site): { remove: true; facility: boolean; body: boolean; status: boolean; allowedStatuses: PlannerSite['status'][] }`. `updateSite`, `removeSite` and BuildOrder must all use it, so the UI and the model can never disagree.
1. It can never be removed, in any status. `removeSite(model, siteId)` (drop the `isPort` parameter) throws for the first site with: "The Primary Port can't be removed. In the game it can only be cancelled together with the whole claim; use Abandon plan to start this system again." Removing any other site is unchanged. Remove the now-unneeded "Wait for the facility list to load before removing the Primary Port." path.
2. Its status can be planned, building or complete, never demolished. Remove "demolished" from its Status options. `updateSite` refuses it with: "The Primary Port can't be demolished (RB-0008)." While planned or building, the status may change between planned, building and complete. Once complete AND placed (`body_ref !== null`), the status is locked, as now.
3. Facility: editable only while planned, and only to another port (as now). Locked while building or complete: the type was fixed when the claim was made.
4. Body: editable while planned. While building or complete, it is locked, EXCEPT while it is Unplaced (`body_ref === null`). Then the commander may set it once, to record where the game put it, and after that it is locked. This keeps the earlier fix: an imported completed primary without a location is never stuck.
5. Name: always editable. It never moves in the order (as now).
6. `isProtectedPrimary` keeps its current meaning (complete and placed), and `replacePlan` keeps using it. Keep the import refusal "This plan's first site is not a port, so it cannot be the Primary Port." and the cross-system confirmation sentence from 38ec952d.
7. Update `PRIMARY_PORT_PROTECTION` to: "The Primary Port can't be removed, and once it is being built its type and body can't change (RB-0008)." Use it as the title of the first step's disabled Move up/down buttons and as the note in its opened edit panel, in place of a Remove button. Keep "RB-0008" in every protection message, since tests match on it.

NEW ACTION "Abandon plan" (the planner's version of cancelling the claim):
- A button in the page header actions, next to Export/Import.
- Disabled when the first site is complete and placed, with title "A completed Primary Port can never be removed (RB-0008)." Also disabled when there are no sites.
- Otherwise it asks `window.confirm`: "Abandon this plan? All <n> sites for <system name> will be removed, as if the claim were cancelled. Slot counts are kept."
- On yes it sets `sites` to [] through the existing `change(...)` path, keeping `slots`. It announces "Plan abandoned." in the existing polite live region. Add a model helper `abandonPlan(model)` that throws `PRIMARY_PORT_PROTECTION` when `isProtectedPrimary` holds for the first site.

DESIGN DOC: in section 2, item 2 ("Add builds."), replace the sentence "They can name it, reorder it, move it to another body or belt, or remove it. The first site is the Primary Port and is labelled as such." with: "They can name it, reorder it, move it to another body or belt, or remove it. The first site is the Primary Port and is labelled as such. As in the game, it can never be removed. Its type and body can change only while it is planned, and it can never be demolished (RB-0008). Abandon plan clears every site, like cancelling the claim, unless the Primary Port is complete."

TESTS (vitest, existing conventions; update the tests 38ec952d added for the old `removeSite` port check):
- removing the first site throws for planned, building and complete;
- removing other sites works;
- each status of the first site: which fields `primaryPortLocks` locks, and `updateSite` enforces the same (facility change refused while building; body change refused while building and placed; body set allowed while building or complete and Unplaced, then refused; demolished refused in every status; complete-and-placed status change refused; planned→building→complete allowed);
- BuildOrder renders no Remove button for the first site in any status, no "demolished" option, and its Facility/Body/Status controls disabled or enabled to match the helper (component test);
- Abandon plan: confirm yes clears sites and keeps slots and announces; confirm no changes nothing; disabled with the title when the primary is complete and placed; disabled with no sites;
- the import tests from 38ec952d still pass.

VALIDATION: in apps/web: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test` (report counts), `pnpm build`. SUMMARY: the helper's signature and behaviour table, each changed file, and the removed code path.
